extra.final_summary: Found and fixed data-quality issues relevant to the question. Three body_mass_g values (rows 22, 28, 49) were impossible out-of-range values (5,050,000 g and 4,050,000 g vs. the rules max of 6,500 g), so they were set to missing. After that, the total body mass by species is: Adelie = 77,000 g, Chinstrap = 53,225 g, Gentoo = 77,600 g. Note: the three excluded masses could materially affect species totals if they were real, but they are biologically impossible as given.
